title: At the market
scenario: You are in a buyer role. Use English naturally in this market situation.

lines.text: Could I see the price list for these items, please?
Of course. Here is today's price list.
The price for organic vegetables is quite high.
I apologise, but the quality is excellent.
I always bargain at the market. Can we negotiate?
If you buy five kilos, I will give you a ten percent discount.
That sounds fair. I will take five kilos.
Thank you. Here is your bill and your change.
